SELECT 
    pm.id,
    pm.name as key
FROM dynamic_models_party_master pm
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tbl_master tm
    JOIN unnest(
        string_to_array(
            trim(both '[]' from pm.role::text),
            ','
        )
    ) AS role_id
    ON trim(role_id) = tm.id::text
    WHERE tm.master_type = 'Role Type'
      AND tm.master_value = 'Supplier'
);
screendefinition_set.auto_patch_query:
WITH selected_party AS (
    SELECT #source_value#::bigint AS party_id
)

SELECT jsonb_build_object(

    -- master data
    '97',
    jsonb_build_object(
        'id', pm.id,
        '97', pm.name,
        '100', pm.email_id,
        '101', pm.mobile_no,
        '103', pm.pan_no,
        '104', pm.ownership_status_ref_id
    ),

    -- additional details
    '107',
    (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', pad.id,
                '107', pad.display_name_as,
                '108', pad.office_no,
                '109', pad.is_tds_applicable,
                '111', pad.payment_terms_ref_id,
                '112', pad.delivery_terms_ref_id,
                '113', pad.mode_of_delivery_ref_id,
                '115', pad.status
            )
        )
        FROM dynamic_models_party_additional_details pad
        WHERE pad.parent_id = pm.id and is_active = true and is_deleted = false
    ),

    -- address details
    '129',
    (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', padd.id,
                '129', padd.country_ref_id_id,
                '130', padd.state_ref_id_id,
                '131', padd.district_ref_id_id,
                '132', padd.sub_district_ref_id_id,
                '133', padd.address,
                '134', padd.pin_code,
                '135', padd.address_type,
                '136', padd.gstin,
                '137', padd.village_ref_id_id
            )
        )
        FROM dynamic_models_party_address_details padd
        WHERE padd.parent_id = pm.id and is_active = true and is_deleted = false
    ),

    -- bank details
    '139',
    (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', pbd.id,
                '139', pbd.bank_name,
                '140', pbd.bank_branch_code,
                '141', pbd.bank_ifsc_code,
                '142', pbd.account_type,
                '143', pbd.bank_account_holder_name,
                '144', pbd.bank_account_no,
                '145', pbd.bank_doc_id,
                '146', pbd.bank_attachment_path
            )
        )
        FROM dynamic_models_party_bank_details pbd
        WHERE pbd.parent_id = pm.id and is_active = true and is_deleted = false
    )

) AS auto_patch_data

FROM dynamic_models_party_master pm
JOIN selected_party sp
    ON pm.id = sp.party_id and is_active = true and is_deleted = false

LIMIT 1;
